title: NASA Videographer of the Year 2019 KSC LRaT entry; UAS aerial imagery of operations during the URT-6 and URT-7 test events
description: Navy divers assist NASA and USS Anchorage (LPD 23) recover a mock-up capsule designed to roughly simulate the size, shape, mass and center of gravity of the Orion crew module that will splash down in the Pacific Ocean following Exploration Mission-1 (EM-1). Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) aerial imagery of operations during Underway Recovery Tests URT-6 and URT-7. This video won second place honors in the Documentation category of NASA's Videographer of the Year 2018 awards for Michael Downs, Jamie Peer, and Isaac Hutson.
keywords: NASA, UAS, EGS, Landing and Recovery, Navy, LPD, VOTY, Videographer of the Year 2018
